name: Maxell, Ltd.
summary: Maxell, Ltd. manufactures and sale energy, functional materials, optics and systems, and Value co-creation solution products in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, and internationally. It offers batteries such as heat-resistant coin-type lithium, coin-type lithium, cylindrical lithium, silver oxide, dry cell, prismatic lithium-ion, and all-solid-state batteries; electrodes for lithium-ion batteries; chargers, battery packs, and electrode application products; adhesive tapes, including building and construction tapes, semiconductor manufacturing process tapes, and industrial process tapes, as well as industrial rubber products, coated separators, and functional materials.
